title: School completion, World, by wealth
headline: In 117 of 122 countries, primary completion was lower among the poorest fifth than the richest
subtitle: Percentage of a cohort of children or young people aged 3-5 years above the intended age for the last grade of primary education who have completed primary education
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 2000 to 2024; median gap 12.6 points.
data_line: Data: UNESCO UIS via UN SDG Global Database, series SE_TOT_CPLR, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: In 117 of 122 countries, primary completion was lower among the poorest fifth than the richest. Latest surveys with both groups, 2000 to 2024; median gap 12.6 points. Gap between the poorest fifth and the richest fifth in 122 countries, ranked; 117 with the poorest fifth lower, 2 with the richest fifth lower.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in primary completion between the poorest fifth and the richest fifth close, and how was it measured?
